audit.whatIsWrong: The packet itself carries the defect: 'level chart contradicts data: Riven wins only 44.64% but the chart gives Riven 4/7 stages vs 0'. Both layers hand Riven First item and 2+ items, and whys[5], whys[6], spikes[3] and late all describe Riven dictating the late game. The lane is a 44.64% loss over 1353 games. diff also reads EVEN at 6/10.
audit.why: A losing matchup was presented as one Riven owns at every item stage — the single most misleading shape a page can have, because it tells the player to keep duelling exactly where the data says they lose.
audit.corrected: First item -> Zaahen, 2+ items -> Zaahen, as matched full/content pairs; ratings dropped to 4/10 and 3/10; diff EVEN -> HARD and diffRating 6/10 -> 7/10. Levels 1-3 stay with Riven, which the early prose supports.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3] claimed the first-item stage is where Riven's full combo threatens a kill; it is where Zaahen's scaling takes over.
audit.why: Determination stacks give him bonus AD and a revive when full, Grim Deliverance heals off the damage it deals, and Aureate Rush deals percent health — all of which grow past a Riven first item.
audit.corrected: spikes[3] and whys[5] now name his sustain as the reason the item stages flip to him.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never names a single Zaahen ability — the whole full layer says only 'Ultimate' — and none of the four applicable interactions from the missing-interactions file appear: his Q heals and is an auto-attack reset, his E deals percent health so armour is the wrong buy, and both sides carry displacement so the knockup race decides trades.
audit.why: Riven's own W stun and Q3 knockback are in a straight race with The Darkin Glaive's recast knockup and Dreaded Return's pull; whoever lands first wins the trade. That is the matchup and it was never stated.
audit.corrected: The Darkin Glaive (Q, 10/9/8/7/6s): double slash, heals, recast knocks up, opens as an auto reset. Dreaded Return (W, 12-14s, 850 range): stab then pull. Aureate Rush (E, 8-10s): dash with percent-health damage. Grim Deliverance (R, 110/95/80s): heals for a portion of damage dealt.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer itemization lists no anti-heal for a champion with healing on both Q and R.
audit.why: Grievous Wounds timing decides every extended trade here.
audit.corrected: whys[5] and late now call for Grievous Wounds; the itemization string itself is mojibake-encoded on disk and was left for the encoding pass.

edits.before: Through 4-5 it reads even: his Q and E contest you whenever he dodges your W.
edits.after: Even at 4-5: his Q is an auto reset, so react to the wind-up, not the cast.

edits.before: Your first-item spike lets the full combo threaten a complete kill — press the advantage.
edits.after: His Determination stacks and Grim Deliverance heal outpace your first item — buy Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Late your mobility and burst keep dictating the side-lane duels against him.
edits.after: Late his revive passive and percent-health E beat your burst — group, do not duel.

edits.before: The full combo now threatens a complete kill — look for it whenever his cooldowns lapse.
edits.after: His healing and Determination stacks outscale your burst — trade only on his cooldowns.

edits.before: Late your mobility and burst dictate the sidelane duels — he simply cannot pin a Riven who spaces her dashes and staggers the shield. Keep dueling on your cooldown timers, dodge the opening beat of his engage, and turn the pressure into a splitpush your team can play the rest of the map around.
edits.after: Late he wins the sidelane duel: Grim Deliverance (110s at rank 1) heals him for part of the damage it deals, his passive revives him at full Determination, and Aureate Rush cuts through armour. Keep Grievous Wounds up, dodge the opening beat of his engage, and split only where your team can rotate to you.

notes: The whole full layer for this matchup refers to Zaahen's abilities as 'Ultimate' — a placeholder, not a name. Real names are available (The Darkin Glaive Q, Dreaded Return W, Aureate Rush E, Grim Deliverance R) but every string carrying them is mojibake-encoded on disk, so I could not safely supply an exact before-string; I fixed focus.text only. This matchup needs a full-layer regeneration pass once the encoding is repaired — flagging it as the highest-value follow-up for riven. Level-chart flips are proposed as two matched pairs.
